_gg_dispersion.description: ggplot2: dispersión con recta de regresión

_gg_dispersion__base.description: R base: dispersión con recta de regresión

body: medias <- aggregate(${1:datos}[, vars], by = list(GRUPO = ${1}[["${6:GRUPO}"]]), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
radar <- rbind(rep(rango[2], length(vars)), rep(rango[1], length(vars)), medias[, vars])
fmsb::radarchart(radar, axistype = 1, seg = rango[2] - rango[1], caxislabels = seq(rango[1], rango[2]),
pcol = colores, plwd = 2, plty = 1, cglcol = "grey70", axislabcol = "grey40")
legend("topright", legend = medias[["GRUPO"]], col = colores, lwd = 2, bty = "n")
_gg_radar.description: fmsb: gráfico radar de las medias de varias variables por grupo
